title: Auli Skiing & Himalayan Retreat

overview:
Experience the Himalayas with Safar Trails’ Auli Skiing & Himalayan Retreat – 4 Nights / 5 Days. Enjoy scenic mountain drives, seasonal skiing, breathtaking Himalayan views, and visits to Rishikesh, Devprayag, Badrinath Temple, and Mana Village, subject to weather and accessibility.

With comfortable stays, transfers, and meals as selected, this package offers the perfect blend of adventure, relaxation, and Himalayan exploration.

itinerary.title: Delhi – Rishikesh – Joshimath
itinerary.description:
Begin your Himalayan holiday with an early-morning departure from Delhi towards Joshimath. Enjoy a scenic drive through the mountains, passing through Rishikesh and Devprayag along the way.

Continue your journey through Uttarakhand’s picturesque Himalayan roads before arriving in Joshimath. Check in to your hotel, relax after the long journey and enjoy dinner.
itinerary.morningActivity: Early-morning departure from Delhi & scenic drive towards the mountains
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Drive via Rishikesh and Devprayag along picturesque Himalayan roads
itinerary.eveningActivity: Arrival in Joshimath, hotel check-in, relaxation, and dinner

itinerary.title: Joshimath – Auli
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, proceed from Joshimath to Auli. Depending on operational status and weather conditions, enjoy a scenic mountain drive or an optional ropeway experience.

On arrival, check in to your hotel or resort and explore the beautiful surroundings. Take in the panoramic Himalayan views and enjoy the peaceful mountain atmosphere.

During the snow season, you can opt for skiing and other snow activities at an additional cost, subject to snow conditions and local availability. Spend the evening at leisure before dinner.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & scenic mountain drive or optional ropeway experience to Auli
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Check in to hotel or resort & explore panoramic Himalayan surroundings
itinerary.eveningActivity: Optional seasonal snow activities & evening at leisure before dinner
itinerary.transfers: Transfer to Auli (drive or optional ropeway)

itinerary.title: Auli Skiing & Himalayan Experience
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, spend the day exploring Auli and enjoying its mountain scenery. During suitable snow conditions, experience skiing with a local instructor and discover the excitement of this popular winter activity.

You can also enjoy seasonal snow activities, take scenic walks around the Auli slopes and admire views of Nanda Devi and other Himalayan peaks when the weather allows.

An optional visit to Gorson Bugyal may be arranged, subject to weather, snow and local accessibility. Return to your hotel in the evening for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & skiing with a local instructor (during suitable snow conditions)
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Scenic walks around Auli slopes, Nanda Devi views & optional Gorson Bugyal excursion
itinerary.eveningActivity: Relaxing evening at the hotel followed by dinner and overnight stay

itinerary.title: Auli – Badrinath – Mana Village – Joshimath
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Badrinath. Visit the revered Badrinath Temple, subject to its opening dates, road access and local conditions.

Continue towards Mana Village, known for its Himalayan setting near the India–Tibet border. Explore the village and nearby attractions wherever access is permitted.

Later, drive back to Joshimath and check in to your hotel. Relax after the day’s sightseeing and enjoy dinner.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast, check-out from Auli, and drive to Badrinath Temple (subject to opening dates & access)
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Excursion to Mana Village near the India–Tibet border and local sightseeing
itinerary.eveningActivity: Scenic drive back to Joshimath, hotel check-in, relaxation, and dinner

itinerary.title: Joshimath – Rishikesh – Delhi
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and begin the return journey towards Delhi via Rishikesh. Enjoy the scenic Himalayan route as you travel back from Uttarakhand’s mountains to the capital.

On arrival in Delhi, you will be dropped at your desired location. Your Auli Skiing & Himalayan Retreat concludes with memorable experiences of mountain scenery, seasonal adventure and Himalayan culture.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast, check-out from Joshimath hotel & begin scenic drive back
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Scenic drive via Rishikesh and mountain foothills towards Delhi
itinerary.eveningActivity: Drop-off at desired location in Delhi; tour concludes

topPlacesToVisit.name: Auli
topPlacesToVisit.description: Auli is the main destination of this holiday, offering beautiful mountain scenery, open slopes and seasonal snow experiences. It is ideal for travellers who want to enjoy Himalayan landscapes and try skiing when conditions are suitable. Top experiences: Seasonal skiing, snow activities, scenic walks and mountain photography.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Joshimath
topPlacesToVisit.description: Joshimath serves as an important base for exploring Auli and nearby Himalayan destinations. Enjoy the surrounding mountain scenery and use your stay to relax between excursions. Top experiences: Mountain views, local exploration and access to Auli.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Rishikesh
topPlacesToVisit.description: Located along the route from Delhi, Rishikesh is known for its spiritual atmosphere and Himalayan foothill scenery. The itinerary includes passing through the town during the onward and return journeys. Top experiences: Scenic views along the route and glimpses of the town, depending on travel time.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Devprayag
topPlacesToVisit.description: Devprayag is a scenic stop along the journey towards Joshimath, known for its river confluence and mountain surroundings. Top experiences: Scenic drive and views of the Himalayan river landscape.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Badrinath Temple
topPlacesToVisit.description: Visit Badrinath Temple during the scheduled excursion on Day 4. Access depends on temple opening dates, road conditions and local arrangements. Top experiences: Temple visit and spiritual sightseeing when open.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Mana Village
topPlacesToVisit.description: Explore Mana Village and its nearby attractions during the excursion from Badrinath to Joshimath. Visits are subject to local permissions, accessibility and available time. Top experiences: Village exploration, mountain scenery and local cultural experiences.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Gorson Bugyal
topPlacesToVisit.description: Gorson Bugyal is an optional excursion from Auli, offering an opportunity to explore a beautiful Himalayan meadow. The visit depends on weather, snow, trail conditions and accessibility. Top experiences: Nature walks, landscape photography and mountain views.

faqs.question: How many days are required for the Auli Skiing & Himalayan Retreat?
faqs.answer: This Safar Trails itinerary is designed for 4 Nights / 5 Days, starting and ending in Delhi.

faqs.question: What is included in the Auli tour package?
faqs.answer: The itinerary covers the planned transfers, hotel or resort stays, sightseeing and meals as selected. The final quotation should specify the exact inclusions, accommodation category, meal plan and vehicle arrangements.

faqs.question: Is skiing included in the Auli package?
faqs.answer: Skiing is listed as an optional activity at an additional cost. It depends on snow conditions, seasonal availability and local arrangements. Confirm instructor fees and equipment rental before booking.

faqs.question: When is the best time to book an Auli skiing tour?
faqs.answer: For a skiing-focused trip, choose a winter travel window and confirm current snow conditions before finalising dates. Snowfall and ski operations vary from season to season, so skiing cannot be guaranteed on every departure.

faqs.question: Is the Auli ropeway included?
faqs.answer: The itinerary mentions a possible ropeway experience, subject to operation and weather conditions. Ropeway tickets and charges should be confirmed in your package quotation.

faqs.question: Can we visit Gorson Bugyal during this trip?
faqs.answer: An optional visit is included in the itinerary. Actual access depends on weather, snow, trail conditions and local accessibility.

faqs.question: Is Badrinath Temple open throughout the year?
faqs.answer: No. Temple visits depend on the official seasonal opening schedule and local travel conditions. Confirm the planned travel dates before booking.

faqs.question: Does the package include a visit to Mana Village?
faqs.answer: Yes, the itinerary includes a visit to Mana Village on Day 4, subject to local permissions, road conditions and accessibility.

faqs.question: Is this Auli tour package suitable for families and couples?
faqs.answer: The trip can suit families, couples and nature lovers interested in mountain scenery and seasonal activities. Travellers should consider winter temperatures, road journeys and the physical requirements of optional walks or skiing.

faqs.question: How can I book the Auli Skiing & Himalayan Retreat with Safar Trails?
